summary_1line: Duryodhana reassures Dhritarashtra, boasting of his allies and personal prowess, insisting the Kaurava host will defeat the Pandavas despite earlier fears.

image_candidates.scene_text: Duryodhana stands before the blind king Dhritarashtra, boasting with raised mace while assembled Kaurava warriors listen.
A council of war with Bhishma, Drona, Kripa, and Karna surrounding Duryodhana as he speaks anxiously of the Pandavas’ allies.
Duryodhana imagines striking Bhima with a crushing mace blow as the giant warrior falls to the ground.
